primitives.name: NaN Score Collapse Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: | `data-ingestion/src/normalizer.ts` | | **G3** double-settle race | Settlement write is now `updateMany({where:{id, result:"PENDING"}})`; the race loser matches 0 rows and skips re-grading/re-stamping/CLV/snapshot.
primitives.assumptions: Non-numeric inputs are indicative of abandoned or pending game states.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When input is not finite, score becomes null to avoid misgrading.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw odds to stable statistical estimates using finite-value filtering.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of non-finite scores collapsed to null during normalization.

primitives.name: Freshness Validation Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: | `app/cockpit/page.tsx` | | **G4** (picks gate) freshness mask | The public picks freshness gate now requires `oddsInserted > 0`, not just `status:"SUCCESS"` — an empty-but-200 odds run can no longer reset the freshness clock and mask staleness.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'oddsInserted': 'timestamp of last odds insertion (seconds since epoch)', 'status': 'game status flag (SUCCESS/PENDING/FAILED)', 'freshness': 'boolean indicating valid odds freshness'}
primitives.assumptions: Freshness depends on both presence of odds and successful status.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Stale odds without insertion time are ignored.

layer2.mapping: Maps time-based freshness to conditional logic in pick validation.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of stale picks masked due to missing oddsInsertion timestamp.

primitives.name: Stripe Billing Fail-Closed Guard
primitives.verbatim_quote: | `ingestion-pipeline/src/settle-sport.ts` (+ test) | | **M4** Stripe fail-open | `mapStripeStatus` default flipped `ACTIVE → INCOMPLETE` (fail-closed billing gate for any future unknown Stripe status).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'unknownStripeStatus': 'boolean indicating unrecognized Stripe status', 'billingStatus': 'final billing outcome (ACTIVE/INCOMPLETE)'}
primitives.assumptions: Unknown statuses must default to closed billing to prevent unauthorized access.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any unrecognized Stripe status triggers incomplete billing state.

layer2.mapping: Enforces conservative billing policy via default fallback logic.
layer2.telemetry: Count of unknown Stripe statuses triggering fail-closed behavior.
